_comment: Genie Doctor's OWN benchmark. Each case is an evidence bundle with a planted (or absent) defect and the categories the agent MUST / MUST NOT flag. The eval harness runs the diagnostic agent over each bundle and measures recall (caught the planted defect) and precision (did not invent problems). This is the Doctor sitting its own exam.

cases.description: Well-curated, benchmarked, high accuracy, no conflicts, valid ground truth.

instructions.content: A DENIAL is a claim where status_label = 'Denied'. Amounts are in USD.
